g.text: Import chain (gontroller): every participant is a chain step (own goroutine), every arrow is a channel
providers, one after another (claim: own grouper, or on)
files flow in; groups flow out one by one, steps run concurrently
first file: asset links from Photos.sqlite
(original, render, Live Photo video); buffer of open
groups, a group goes out when all its files arrived
[not claimed: on to the next provider (Immich, ... later)]
sidecars by name, next to each other
(buffer: one open group; a complete group goes out)
a provider not enabled is not in the chain:
its files are a plain folder's
what the browser shows now, no transcode:
the main file (JPEG, PNG, ...; H.264 video) /
the biggest viewable derivative / an embedded preview
(exiftool -b into the cache); any size counts
items at once. Ready comes later from
every step: to its grouper and on
after the marker from every branch:
deletions (V2), only after a complete walk,
the last group of the walk is done (items + errors counted)
rescan pause (1 min), then walk again
One asset again (Apple Photos on demand)
Photos made a file of an asset local
Regroup(uuid): the last load's DB rows
+ the disk now (no walk, no DB read)
only what changed passes; no marker,
the item is done: the request waiting
